name: Speak text
description: Synthesises speech from text and stores it as an audio file in the caller's private DLFS speech drive: by default Ogg/Opus (the format of a voice note), or WAV from the local engine, which makes nothing else. Returns {ref, mediaType, size, fileName, format, voice, model, engine}; an Ogg/Opus ref can be sent as a Telegram voice note. To play speech at once without storing it, use speech:say.

voice.description: Voice: a name for a provider elsewhere, a number such as 0 for the local engine; defaults to the venue's configured voice.

model.description: Speech model; defaults to the venue's configured model, the only one the local engine runs.

format.description: Audio format; opus (the default, except from the local engine) is Ogg/Opus, as voice notes are. The local engine makes wav only.

language.description: The text's language as a code such as en or fr, for the local engine (default en); others ignore it.

instructions.description: Optional guidance on tone or delivery, for models that take it.

destination.description: Directory to store the audio in, written with the caller's authority; defaults to the caller's private dlfs/speech/ drive.

fileName.description: A safe single filename; otherwise one is generated. Nothing is overwritten.

apiKey.description: Optional s/NAME reference to the caller's own key; by default the operator's key, else the caller's s/OPENAI_API_KEY, else none.
